overview: Manipal Academy of Higher Education (MAHE) is a deemed-to-be university with Institution of Eminence status, offering over 370 programs across 36 disciplines. It emphasizes research, innovation, sustainability, and entrepreneurship, with global collaborations and strong industry linkages. The Grants Office supports faculty and researchers in identifying, applying for, and managing external research grants to improve research outcomes and funding quality.
objectives: Identify, apply and secure external grants
Improve the quantum & quality of the grant proposal
Aid in improving the strike rate of application
Support and educate researchers with knowledge on grant proposal writing and funding trends
Assist applicants with necessary approvals, consultations, policies & documents
Establish worthy linkage with funding agencies to understand funding trends
Nurture interdisciplinary collaborations within MAHE institutions
eligibility: MAHE faculty and researchers are eligible to seek support from the Grants Office for identifying, applying, and managing external research grants. The office assists with proposal writing, budgeting, institutional approvals, and coordination with finance, legal, and HR teams during grant implementation.
benefits: Services include quick identification of grant calls, customized email notifications, proposal writing workshops, budgeting and mentorship, assistance with mandatory documents and institutional approvals, legal consultation for MOUs/Agreements, review of unsuccessful proposals for re-submission, and management of research funds with financial auditing.
financial_support: The Grants Office facilitates access to external research grants from government funding agencies such as DST, DBT, ICMR, DRDO, ISRO, SERB, CSIR, ICSSR, AICTE, UGC, etc. It does not directly provide financial support but helps researchers secure funding from these external agencies.
application_process: 1. Identify relevant grant calls through the Grants Office’s notification system. 2. Receive customized emails about open calls. 3. Utilize services like budgeting, mentorship, and proposal review, and guidance. 4. Prepare mandatory documents and coordinate institutional approvals and signatures. 5. Submit application with required approvals. 6. Post-submission, the office assists with legal consultation for MOUs/Agreements. 7. If proposal is not funded, review and suggest improvements for re-submission. 8. Upon award, the office helps manage research funds and financial auditing.
deadlines: Rolling basis — grants are processed as calls are announced by funding agencies.
implementing_agency: Directorate of Research, Manipal Academy of Higher Education (MAHE)
caveats: The Grants Office does not provide direct funding; it facilitates access to external grants.
Support is contingent on researcher engagement and timely submission of documents.
Financial auditing and fund management are provided only after grant award.
